Thanks — the five cmdlets will be present at runtime; this is a consequence of how this repo stores generated code, not a real gap.

The shipping module is generated from the AutoRest config in `src/Datadog/Datadog.Autorest/README.md` at build time, into `src/Datadog/Datadog.Autorest/generated/` (which is `.gitignore`d). That build output contains the `exports/` scripts for all five cmdlets, so `FunctionsToExport` in `Az.Datadog.psd1` correctly matches the built module.

The top-level `generated/Datadog/Datadog.Autorest` referenced here is a separate checked-in mirror that is **not** updated by feature PRs — it's regenerated and committed post-merge by the automated "Archive" pipeline (`[skip ci] Archive …` commits). The previous Datadog feature PR (#28832) followed the same pattern: it updated `FunctionsToExport` in `src/` and touched zero files under `generated/`; the corresponding `exports/` scripts appeared under `generated/Datadog/` only afterward, via an Archive commit.

So no change is needed here — the exports resolve correctly from the build config, and the checked-in mirror will catch up post-merge.
We don't check in `generated` folder. As the name suggests, this folder will be generated in build time.
